hypothesis: Question-dependent broader eligibility (observers of current conditions by directory group) answers more gaps than direct-contributors-only without more wrong recipients.

variants.description: library default: firsthand case/entity links, empty observability policy (reference, not part of the rule)
empty observability policy; recipients restricted to people with a firsthand link to the question's own case
configured observability policy by directory group (experiments/config.ts) on top of firsthand links

config.policyNote: written from group names visible in people.json before running; never tuned
config.directOnly: wrapper generator filters candidate recipients to personLink.caseId === gap case, firsthand

acceptanceCriteria: question-dependent ships if its wrong-recipient rate does not rise by more than 0.02 over direct-only (a null rate, no questions, is read as 0) (EXPERIMENT_PLAN.md E06)
